{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print(sales.head())

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print("\nQA orders with revenue 999999.99:")
print(sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check if any of these loyal customers have refunded status
print("\nRefunded orders among loyal customers:")
print(loyal_customers[loyal_customers['status'] == 'refunded'])

# Compute conversion rate for loyal customers
converted_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
conversion_fraction = converted_loyal / total_loyal

print(f"\nTotal loyal customers: {total_loyal}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_fraction"}
